justification: In `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/build/AccessControllerPlugin.java:355-372`, `WithoutProperty` is a tiny nested subclass of `Initializer` with no fields, one constructor, and one overridden method (`onAccessController`) that only emits `ICONST_1` and returns `1`. Its behavior is a single, isolated strategy for the no-property branch of the enclosing plugin, not a class with multiple responsibilities or separable concerns. `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/build/AccessControllerPluginTest.java` exercises this branch via `new AccessControllerPlugin()` and confirms the intended single purpose.
